name: Abdelbaki HAMDOUNI
basis: The pinned read-only review classifies this exact tiny residential way as clear_residential_complex_or_building: its sole OSM identity is an individual's full name and landuse=residential, with no place or boundary identity. The review recommends only this exact-ID picker exclusion.
scope: This removes the one feature record from the shipped locality/GPS-label catalog and records its ID as retired for stale saved-selection handling. It does not change source/master geometry: the neighborhoods.bin bytes are preserved unchanged, and a byte-for-byte pre-change backup is retained. It makes no claim that the source object, structure, ownership, or area does not exist.

expectedEffects.savedSelectionFallback: Retired raw locality ID resolves to null locality ID/name/kind while preserving the saved delegation ID and fromGps flag; the existing delegation timetable source remains unchanged.
